the act: *** ANTONINA ISABEL LERENA DE PELAEZ, DEAD AT NINETY-TWO - AND THIS IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS ***
what it says: *** Flores. Death Records 1888-1917 ***, image 271, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-Q7WL, acta No. 9 of *** 28 July 1911 ***, before Esteban Indarte, Juez de Paz de la Sexta seccion. *** PLATE READ 10 October 2026: *** 'ha fallecido *** ANTONINA ISABEL LERENA DE PELAEZ ***, de nacionalidad oriental, *** NACIDA EN MONTEVIDEO ***, de *** NOVENTA Y DOS ANOS *** de edad, de estado *** viuda ***... a consecuencia de miocarditis cronica... Que la finada era *** hija legitima de Don RAMON LERENA y de Dona MARIA GONZALEZ, fallecidos. Abuelos paternos y maternos: ignorados ***. ...el primer declarante es *** NIETO de la extinta ***... que esta era *** viuda de Don JUAN PEDRO PELAEZ *** y *** deja de sucesion, cuatro hijos y son: CASIMIRA JOSEFA, MALBINO HIPOLITO, MARIA INOCENCIA y JUAN FABIAN ***'. Died at *** Cerro Colorado ***, on her own estancia.
what it settles: *** THE APEX OF THE 1858 KINSHIP DIAGRAM, CONFIRMED FROM A CIVIL REGISTER FIFTY-THREE YEARS LATER AND IN A DIFFERENT RECORD SYSTEM. *** A priest drew Ramon Lerena and Maria Gonzalez over Alejandro and Antonina; a Juez de Paz now writes Antonina as their legitimate daughter. *** TWO INDEPENDENT DOCUMENTS, ONE COUPLE. *** *** AND IT NAMES HER FOUR SURVIVING CHILDREN, THREE OF WHOM THIS ARCHIVE ALREADY HELD SEPARATELY: *** *** CASIMIRA JOSEFA *** is the Casimira Pelaez who married Bernabe Lerena in 1858; *** MARIA INOCENCIA *** is the Maria Pelaez who married Rafael Sanchez in 1880; *** MALBINO HIPOLITO *** is the Malbino/Balbino Pelaez of the 1880 witness list and the 1890s confirmations; and *** JUAN FABIAN *** is new.

the act: *** AND IT CORRECTS HER AGE AND HER BIRTHPLACE ***
what it says: *** Ninety-two in July 1911, so born about 1819 ***; and *** NACIDA EN MONTEVIDEO ***
what it settles: *** THIS REGISTER HAS CARRIED HER AS BORN ABOUT 1830 ***, inferred from a daughter aged thirty in 1880. *** THE ACT STATES NINETY-TWO, WHICH IS ELEVEN YEARS EARLIER ***, and a stated age beats an inferred one. *** AND IT CONTRADICTS THE 1858 EXPEDIENTE ***, which calls Juan Pelaez and Antonina Lerena *** 'naturales de SAN JOSE' ***. *** SHE WAS BORN AT MONTEVIDEO. *** Recorded as a conflict, not resolved by preference - though the 1911 act is the one with a stated age and a grandson standing in the room. *** AND IT FITS RAMON'S OWN HOUSEHOLD: *** this archive holds three of his children christened at Montevideo between 1812 and 1821 - Union, Cordon and the Catedral.

the act: *** AND A CANDIDATE THIS ARCHIVE WILL NOT MERGE ***
what it says: An earlier index sweep returned *** ANTONIA LUISA, christened 1819 at CORDON, MONTEVIDEO, daughter of RAMON LLERENA and MARIA JOSEFA GONZALEZ ***
what it settles: *** SAME YEAR, SAME CITY, SAME PARENTS, AND IT IS STILL NOT AN IDENTIFICATION. *** 'Antonia Luisa' is not 'Antonina Isabel', and this archive has spent two days correcting identifications made on exactly this much. *** DECLARED AS A CANDIDATE IN data/_person-pairs.txt *** rather than merged. *** THE TEST: *** the Cordon baptism act itself, which is held on film and has not been opened.

the act: *** ALEJANDRINA LERENA DE PELAEZ - THE WOMAN THIS ARCHIVE COULD ONLY INFER YESTERDAY ***
what it says: *** Flores. Death Records March 1918-January 1919 *** (the volume runs past its title), image 85, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-QNVC, acta of *** 28 January 1926 *** at Estacion Juan Jose Castro. *** PLATE READ: *** 'fallecio *** ALEJANDRINA LERENA DE PELAEZ ***... nacida en esta Seccion, de *** setenta y cuatro anos ***, de estado *** viuda ***... a consecuencia de asistolia... Que la finada era *** hija de ALEJANDRO LERENA y de YSIDORA CHOUSINA, ambos fallecidos. Abuelos paternos: ALEJANDRO LERENA y MARGARITA FERNANDEZ. Abuelos maternos: se ignora ***... el primer declarante es *** hijo de la extinta ***' - he being Don Juan Pedro Pelaez, forty-one, agricultor.
what it settles: *** YESTERDAY THIS ARCHIVE WROTE 'a daughter of his by Isidora Chourino married MALVINO PELAEZ' AND COULD NOT NAME HER. HER NAME IS ALEJANDRINA. *** Born about *** 1852 *** in the Sexta Seccion. *** AND HER PATERNAL GRANDPARENTS CONFIRM THE 1854 EXPEDIENTE FROM A SECOND ACT SEVENTY-TWO YEARS LATER: *** Alejandro Lerena the younger is a son of *** ALEJANDRO LERENA and MARGARITA FERNANDEZ ***. *** AND ISIDORA'S SURNAME NOW HAS A THIRD SPELLING: *** CHONZENO on the 1854 transcript, CHOURINO on the 1900s Flores act, *** CHOUSINA on this plate ***. *** NONE OF THE THREE IS PREFERRED HERE. ***

the act: *** AMADOR LERENA PELAEZ - A SECOND CHILD FOR THE 1894 DISPENSATION COUPLE ***
what it says: *** Durazno. Death Records 1936-1937 ***, image 167, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-DQ4K-7, acta of *** 31 January 1937 ***: 'fallecio *** AMADOR LERENA PELAEZ ***, del sexo masculino, de nacionalidad oriental, *** nacido en la SEXTA SECCION DE FLORES ***, de *** treinta y cinco anos *** de edad, de estado soltero, de profesion *** peluquero ***, a consecuencia de sincope cardiaco... que el finado era *** hijo legitimo de don JUAN LERENA y de dona EDUVIGES PELAEZ, orientales ***, [ambos] fallecido[s]; abuelos paternos y maternos: se ignoran'. He died on Calle Ituzaingo, Durazno.
what it settles: *** THE COUPLE DISPENSED ON 31 MARCH 1894 HAVE A SECOND CHILD. *** Yesterday gave them NEPOMUCENO TEOFILO, baptised at Trinidad in 1905; this gives *** AMADOR, born about 1901 in the same Sexta Seccion ***, dead a bachelor and a barber at Durazno in 1937. *** AND IT DATES BOTH PARENTS' DEATHS: *** Juan Lerena and Eduviges Pelaez are both *** fallecidos by January 1937 ***, which is the first terminus this archive has for either of them.

the act: *** AND TWO MORE CHILDREN, FROM A CONFIRMATION REGISTER ***
what it says: *** Santisima Trinidad. Confirmation Records October 1891-November 1905 ***, image 5, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-F3QH-N: '*** Luis, hijo legitimo de BALBINO PELAEZ y ALEJANDRINA LERENA = [padrino] Juan Pelaez ***; *** Aurora, [idem] = MARGARITA LERENA ***' - and, two lines later, *** ALEJANDRINA LERENA *** standing godmother to a child of Pablo Moyano and Delfina Fernandez
what it settles: *** THE REGISTER WRITES HIM BALBINO WHERE THE DEATH ACT WRITES MALBINO ***, and his mother's death act of 1911 gives his full name as *** MALBINO HIPOLITO ***. *** ONE MAN, THREE FORMS ***, and the Don Balbino Pelaez who witnessed Maria Pelaez's wedding in 1880 is him. *** FOUR CHILDREN NOW FOR BALBINO AND ALEJANDRINA: *** Luis and Aurora here, Antonio Eusebio by his death act, and Juan Pedro who declared both his mother's death and his grandmother's. *** AND A NEW LERENA WOMAN: MARGARITA LERENA ***, godmother at Trinidad in the 1890s, who is not the Margarita Fernandez of the apex generation.
